exposure: Laboratory parameters (C-reactive protein, white blood cell count, amniotic fluid sludge)
cohort: The cohort consisted of 462 pregnant women who underwent McDonald cerclage at a single hospital.
finding: A Random Forest (RF) machine learning model provided a clinically useful and interpretable framework for predicting outcomes after cerclage, with inflammatory status, maternal characteristics, and cerclage indication identified as key determinants of preterm birth.
